name: Refracted Text
description: Glass letters with an optional character lift, adjustable opening flow, customizable glass, beam and spectral colors, original font contours and a refracted beam.

controls.name: text
controls.label: Text
controls.description: A short word works best for large display lettering.

controls.name: theme
controls.label: Theme
controls.description: Dark by default, independently of the page. Choose Light for a white surface, or Auto to follow the inherited color scheme.

controls.name: topColor
controls.label: Top color
controls.description: CSS color for the upper glass. Auto preserves the original theme palette. The beam and edge highlights keep their lighting.

controls.name: bottomColor
controls.label: Bottom color
controls.description: CSS color for the lower glass. Auto preserves the original theme palette. Colors blend through the middle of each letter.

controls.name: beamColor
controls.label: Beam color
controls.description: CSS color for the refracted beam and its bright highlights, independent of the glass colors. Auto preserves the original spectral light.

controls.name: reveal
controls.label: Character lift
controls.description: On by default: lift each letter into place. Turn off to keep the text static while the original light flow plays.

controls.name: liftDuration
controls.label: Lift duration (s)
controls.description: Total time from the first letter starting to rise until the last letter settles. Includes the character stagger.

controls.name: stagger
controls.label: Character stagger (s)
controls.description: Total delay from the first letter to the last. The lift has no opacity fade.

controls.name: ease
controls.label: Easing curve
controls.description: Curve for the upward lift of each character; the shader's light flow keeps its original timing.

controls.name: beamFollowsLift
controls.label: Beam follows letters
controls.description: Off keeps the light beam fixed in the preview while letters rise. On moves the beam with each glyph, as in the previous lift.

controls.name: animateBeam
controls.label: Animate beam
controls.description: Turn off the automatic beam flow and show its settled appearance immediately. Character lift and cursor interaction remain active.

controls.name: openingDuration
controls.label: Opening flow (s)
controls.description: One power4.out flow curve spans the whole word; it does not restart for each letter. Static flow (original) retains its continuous cycle.

controls.name: duration
controls.label: Light cycle (s)
controls.description: Time for the light cycle. With character lift it stops after the entrance; static flow keeps cycling.

controls.name: intensity
controls.label: Refraction intensity
controls.description: Brightness of the white ray and its spectral color. Use Color separation to widen the existing spectral colors.

controls.name: spectrumWarmColor
controls.label: Beam color 1
controls.description: CSS color for this spectral ray. Auto keeps the beam palette. Color separation controls its coverage without widening the bright core.

controls.name: spectrumMiddleColor
controls.label: Beam color 2
controls.description: CSS color for this spectral ray. Auto keeps the beam palette. Color separation controls its coverage without widening the bright core.

controls.name: spectrumCoolColor
controls.label: Beam color 3
controls.description: CSS color for this spectral ray. Auto keeps the beam palette. Color separation controls its coverage without widening the bright core.

controls.name: dispersion
controls.label: Color separation
controls.description: Area covered by the three chosen spectral colors. Increase to spread them through the glass without widening the bright beam. Auto colors retain the original spectrum.

controls.name: colorIntensity
controls.label: Color intensity
controls.description: Strength of the chosen spectral colors, independent of the bright beam and Color separation coverage.

controls.name: beamPosition
controls.label: Fixed beam height
controls.description: Same vertical position as the cursor in Cursor moves beam: 0 is the top edge and 1 is the bottom edge.

controls.name: fixedBeam
controls.label: Fixed beam
controls.description: Hold the beam at the chosen height until the cursor moves it.

controls.name: paused
controls.label: Pause animation
controls.description: Hold the automatic cycle; the cursor can still bend the ray.

controls.name: cursorMovesBeam
controls.label: Cursor moves beam
controls.description: Steer the whole ray with the cursor. Off by default so the cursor bends it locally.

controls.name: fontSize
controls.label: Font size (CSS)
controls.description: CSS size of the letters, constrained to the available width.

controls.name: fontFamily
controls.label: Font family
controls.description: Bundled Square Display preserves the original alphabet with a squarer uppercase O. The original Librestile face also remains available.

controls.name: fontWeight
controls.label: Font weight
controls.description: Weight of the lettering.

controls.name: extraBold
controls.label: Extra bold (%)
controls.description: Expand the actual glyph outline with angular joins; corner rounding remains independent.

controls.name: fontHeight
controls.label: Font height (%)
controls.description: Compress the natural height of the lettering without changing its width.

controls.name: cornerRounding
controls.label: Corner rounding (%)
controls.description: Soften the glyph corners independently of Extra bold.

controls.name: letterSpacing
controls.label: Letter spacing (CSS)
controls.description: Uses the font's natural spacing unless you set a value.
